classification: expiry-day non-directional index-option straddle across the NSE/BSE closing auction session (measurement deployment, issue #740)

NIFTY.weekly_expiry: Tuesday (master contract decides; shifts on holidays)

SENSEX.weekly_expiry: Thursday (master contract decides; shifts on holidays)

instrument: current-week ATM CE + ATM PE, same strike, expiring today
order_type: MARKET in sandbox; marketable LIMIT (ask + 5 ticks / bid - 5 ticks) in live
atm_basis: spot at 15:15:00 IST (last continuous print) -> nearest listed strike
target_rule: combined BID value of the open legs, net of modelled exit charges, >= target_mult x entry cost for 2 consecutive polls

ui_config.table: cas_straddle_config (single row; NULL = code default; no env seeds)

lot_multiple: read from SymToken.lotsize at the 15:12 arm (NIFTY 65 / SENSEX 20 as of 2026-09); never overridable
ladder_recorded: ATM +/-2 strikes, both sides, both underlyings, every poll, regardless of the trade toggles
stop_loss: none - the premium paid is the max loss; no averaging, no re-entry
kill_criteria: SEBI/NSE discontinue the IIV display or move expiry settlement to a VWAP -> operator flips to sandbox; pre-registered in PLAN.md
charges_model: Zerodha schedule verified 2026-09-19: Rs20/order, STT 0.15% sell-side premium, NSE 0.03553% / BSE 0.0325% of premium, SEBI Rs10/cr, stamp 0.003% buy, GST 18%
backtest_reference: none yet - R69 runs on the strategy's own cas_straddle_polls / cas_straddle_sessions (no historical weekly index-option data exists)
llm_context: cas_320_expiry_straddle buys the at-the-money call AND put on NIFTY (Tuesday, NFO) and SENSEX (Thursday, BFO) weekly expiry days at 15:20 IST, one to ten lots each, NRML, and sells both when the combined bid reaches a multiple of the premium paid (default 2x) or at a hard time exit before the 15:40 derivatives close. It is a non-directional bet that the closing-auction indicative index swings further than the straddle costs. The premium paid is the maximum loss. It is a measurement deployment: no historical data exists for a backtest, so the strategy records every 2-second quote of the ATM ladder across the auction on every expiry day.
